title: Managing custom nodes with ComfyUI-Manager (legacy UI)
key_points: ComfyUI-Manager allows installation, updating, and management of custom nodes using the legacy interface.
The documentation provides a guide on how to use the ComfyUI-Manager for these purposes.
It includes steps and explanations on performing these tasks with the ComfyUI-Manager.
